tasks.title: Rename getItemTotal to lineTotal
tasks.prompt:
Rename the function getItemTotal to lineTotal everywhere: its definition and export in src/cart.js, its uses in src/report.js and test/cart.test.js, and the mention in README.md. Change nothing else.

Verify: node --test test/cart.test.js test/report.test.js passes, and git grep -n getItemTotal finds nothing.

tasks.title: Add slugify with tests
tasks.prompt:
Add src/slugify.js exporting slugify(text): lower-case the text, replace every run of characters other than a-z and 0-9 with one '-', and remove any leading and trailing '-'. So '  Hello, World!  ' is 'hello-world', 'Café au lait' is 'caf-au-lait', and '---' is ''. Add test/slugify.test.js with node:test cases (as in the other test files) for those three examples and at least two more.

Verify: node --test test/slugify.test.js passes.

tasks.title: Add a CSV line parser
tasks.prompt:
Add src/csv.js exporting parseCsvLine(line), which splits one CSV line into an array of strings. Fields are separated by commas. A field wrapped in double quotes may contain commas, and "" inside it is one literal quote. An empty line is one empty field (['']); empty fields are ''; spaces are kept as they are; a quote that is never closed throws an Error. test/csv.test.js already has the cases: don't change it.

Verify: node --test test/csv.test.js passes, and test/csv.test.js is unchanged.

tasks.title: Group thousands in every price
tasks.prompt:
Show prices with thousands separators everywhere. Change formatPrice in src/format.js so whole dollars are grouped in threes with commas: 123456789 cents is '$1,234,567.89', and -123456 is '-$1,234.56'; amounts under $1,000 look as they do now. Change src/report.js to format every amount with formatPrice instead of its own toFixed formatting; its rows keep their shape. Add cases to test/format.test.js and test/report.test.js for amounts of $1,000.00 or more, and keep the existing cases passing.

Verify: node --test test/format.test.js test/report.test.js test/cart.test.js passes, and git grep -n toFixed -- src finds nothing.

tasks.title: Fix parseDuration
tasks.prompt:
test/duration.test.js fails. Find out why and fix src/duration.js so the whole file passes; the comment at the top of src/duration.js says what parseDuration must do. Don't change the test.

Verify: node --test test/duration.test.js passes, and test/duration.test.js is unchanged.
